reason: A client-side DSH Web UI plugin that visualizes session execution state in the input dock, including todo progress, timing, reported ETA, estimated token generation rate, interruption status, and pending interaction alerts.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 输入框停靠区显示会话进度、耗时、预计剩余时间、令牌生成速率及中断和待处理交互状态。
summaries.en: Displays session progress, elapsed time, reported ETA, estimated token generation rate, interruption status, and pending interaction alerts in the DSH Web UI input dock.

capabilities: Browser-side rendering of a persistent session progress bar
Reads DSH session snapshots, todos, timing, and interaction state
Displays execution progress, elapsed time, reported ETA, estimated token rate, interruption state, and pending interaction alerts
